title: Correctness of the path reduction
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $L$ be a language of bit strings, and let $c_0$ be a natural number. Suppose that on every input $x$, all choice sequences of some common length $T$ halt, every such computation uses at most $c_0(\lfloor\log_2(|x|)\rfloor+1)$ work-tape cells, and $N$ accepts $x$ exactly when $x\in L$. Then, for every bit string $x$, $x\in L$ if and only if the reduction string constructed from $N,c_0,x$ encodes a path from vertex $0$ to vertex $1$ in the associated raw graph.
